chunk.content: Rastrelliger mackerels, the genus sold as gembolo in West Sumatra, have a blue-green back with two rows of small dark spots along the dorsal fin bases.
chunk.source_quote: Colour: back blue-green with 2 rows of small, dark spots on sides of dorsal fin bases

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2. Scombrids of the World (Collette & Nauen 1983), section incl. Rastrelliger
